## Problem Statement

This project models subscriber churn and Average Revenue Per User (ARPU)
for an Indian telecom operator, combining:

-  **Revenue-at-Risk Churn Prediction** — churn probability weighted by
    each customer's ARPU, so business impact (not just accuracy) drives
    prioritization.
-  **Customer Segmentation** — unsupervised clustering to identify
    distinct subscriber groups (e.g. high-value data users,
    price-sensitive prepaid, loyal low-usage) with different churn
    drivers.
-   **Explainable Root-Cause Diagnosis** — SHAP-based explanations per
    segment, translating model output into specific, actionable churn
    drivers.
-  **Differentiated Retention Strategy & ROI** — segment-specific
    retention recommendations, costed against projected revenue saved.
-  **Competitive Tariff Context** — TRAI market-level ARPU/tariff/MOU
    data used to benchmark findings against real Indian telecom market
    trends.
